subject: Civic Hall calendar or event-detail listing
method: CDX / Wayback review of Civic Hall captures and event-prefix URLs.
scope: 4,630 deduplicated HTML captures representing 1,240 original URLs, plus 296 distinct event URL keys: 215 successful pages, 74 redirects, and seven 404 captures.
conclusion: No Wayback-captured Civic Hall calendar listing or dedicated event-detail page was recovered for the January 2016 New York City Council constituent-services hackathon.
limitation: This documents the scope and result of the search. It does not prove that no listing ever existed.
